title: Goal-Drift Pressure Dial: A Reusable Drift-Elicitation Suite

original_idea.body: # Goal-Drift Pressure Dial: A Reusable Drift-Elicitation Suite

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: goal drift is a long-horizon diffuse-reward failure; tunable elicitation enables robustness characterization.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: YAML-driven pressure-knob framework over an open model, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (per-model drift-onset curves from a configurable suite).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected long-horizon failure labs underinvest in; reusable tool, no training.

novelty.reasoning: Drift studied as fixed scenarios; tunable-dial suite may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A tunable pressure-dial drift suite likely does not exist.
